course_description: This course provides an introduction to the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI), focusing on its application to solve real-world problems that are challenging to address using traditional algorithmic approaches. Students will explore key AI methodologies, including techniques for handling uncertainty, learning from experience, and applying nature-inspired problem-solving strategies. The course covers both the theoretical foundations and practical aspects of developing intelligent systems. Additionally, it addresses the ethical considerations in AI development, preparing students for careers in AI, data science, and related fields.

demonstrate the various techniques and methods that algorithms in artificial intelligence employ within the context of Data Science;
utilize expertise in intelligent systems, encompassing AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning;
develop an application program for a designated intelligent system project using programming language tools, and subsequently compose a research paper and deliver a presentation; and
demonstrate 21 century skills in all learning activities. st
